raw_response:
I have only 0.37 hectares, so I must make every bit of it count. I managed to get fertilizer and hybrid seed through the FISP coupon this year because the extension worker knows my family, and I will put everything on this one plot since it is my only land. We have no irrigation here in Mwanza, and I cannot afford pesticides for food maize. My wife and I will do all the work ourselves—land preparation, planting, weeding twice, and harvesting by hand—because the plot is small and I have no extra money to hire ganyu labor.
